byField.alerted_listen_time: How long it stands listening after a noise, in frames, before going back to its business.
byField.amount_of_panic_sounds: Read by nothing in either game.
byField.animation_id: Which entry of the background-animation table draws here; Exoddus wells keep the field but never read it.
byField.asleep: Whether the creature starts asleep, before anything wakes it.
byField.camera: The destination's camera number, within the destination path.
byField.chase_abe_when_spotted: Whether a Slig that has spotted Abe follows him off its screen, or stays put and keeps acting on the sighting.
byField.code_1: The first half of a password, written as decimal digits; the two code fields join into one digit string, read left to right.
byField.code_2: The second half of a password, written as decimal digits; the two code fields join into one digit string, read left to right.
byField.disable_resources: A bitmask of animation sets the screen skips loading: a memory budget, not a behaviour switch; on several types nothing reads it at all.
byField.disabled_resources: A bitmask of animation sets the screen skips loading: a memory budget, not a behaviour switch; which bit means what varies per type, and several types never read theirs at all.
byField.dont_shoot: Read by nothing in either game.
byField.emit_leaves: Whether the well puffs drifting leaves; they gate on the same switch as the ride.
byField.exit_x: The pop-out shot when someone arrives at this well; Exoddus reads a landing offset, Oddysee a velocity in hundredths of a unit.
byField.exit_y: The pop-out shot when someone arrives at this well; Exoddus reads a landing offset, Oddysee a velocity in hundredths of a unit.
byField.give_password: Whether the greeting teaches the password before the payoff.
byField.give_ring_without_password: Skips the whole greeting: the gift is handed over as soon as both are on screen.
byField.give_up_chase_delay: Frames of idling after losing Abe before the chase is dropped, plus a little jitter.
byField.grenade_delay: The throw cooldown in frames, plus a little jitter, floored at twenty.
byField.input_switch_id_1: One of the gate's watched inputs; unused slots carry the always-on id 1 (one blank syncer leaves zeros and can never fire).
byField.input_switch_id_2: One of the gate's watched inputs; unused slots carry the always-on id 1 (one blank syncer leaves zeros and can never fire).
byField.input_switch_id_3: One of the gate's watched inputs; unused slots carry the always-on id 1 (one blank syncer leaves zeros and can never fire).
byField.input_switch_id_4: One of the gate's watched inputs; unused slots carry the always-on id 1 (one blank syncer leaves zeros and can never fire).
byField.input_switch_id_5: One of the gate's watched inputs; unused slots carry the always-on id 1 (one blank syncer leaves zeros and can never fire).
byField.input_switch_id_6: One of the gate's watched inputs; unused slots carry the always-on id 1 (one blank syncer leaves zeros and can never fire).
byField.kill_enemy: Unreachable dead code: the condition short-circuits before it is ever evaluated.
byField.launch_grenade_switch_id: An unpossessed flying slig throws only while this switch reads on.
byField.left_max_delay: The longest stand at the patrol's end while facing left.
byField.left_min_delay: The shortest stand at the patrol's end while facing left.
byField.level: Which level the destination sits in.
byField.max_velocity: Rail speed in world units per frame; ignored the moment you possess it.
byField.movie_id: Which film the change plays; zero means an instant change with no movie.
byField.movie_number: Which film plays, from the current level's own movie table: the same number is a different film in another level.
byField.noise_wake_up_distance: How far a noise reaches a sleeper, in grid squares.
byField.other_well_id: This well's own arrival number: the id an express ride names to come out here.
byField.output_switch_id: The switch the gate writes its answer into.
byField.output_switch_id_1: One of the four outputs the trigger toggles; a slot left at zero, or at the untouchable id 1, does nothing.
byField.output_switch_id_2: One of the four outputs the trigger toggles; a slot left at zero, or at the untouchable id 1, does nothing.
byField.output_switch_id_3: One of the four outputs the trigger toggles; a slot left at zero, or at the untouchable id 1, does nothing.
byField.output_switch_id_4: One of the four outputs the trigger toggles; a slot left at zero, or at the untouchable id 1, does nothing.
byField.panic_delay: Frames of cowering while Abe chants, plus a little jitter.
byField.panic_sound_timeout: Read by nothing in either game.
byField.panic_timeout: How long it panics when Abe chants or an alarm sounds, in frames. Zero switches panicking off entirely.
byField.path: The destination's path number, within the destination level.
byField.patrol_pause_max: Inert as shipped: jitter is only added when min exceeds max, and no placement does that.
byField.patrol_pause_min: The pause at each end of the rail, in frames.
byField.patrol_type_run_or_walk_chance: How often a patrol leg is run rather than walked. It is re-rolled every leg, and a higher value means more running.
byField.pause_after_chase_delay: The hunt-from-memory grace: refreshed every frame the target is visible, the chase only drops once sight is lost and this has expired.
byField.pause_left_max: The longest stand at a patrol end while facing left; jitter is added only when max exceeds min.
byField.pause_left_min: The shortest stand at a patrol end while facing left. Which pair applies follows the facing, not which end it reached.
byField.pause_right_max: The longest stand at a patrol end while facing right; jitter is added only when max exceeds min.
byField.pause_right_min: The shortest stand at a patrol end while facing right. Which pair applies follows the facing, not which end it reached.
byField.pause_time: Frames before its first move; the chase-and-disappear state reuses it as its beat.
byField.percent_beat_mudokon: The chance of beating a Mudokon it finds, rolled against 0 to 255, so it is not a percentage: 15 is about six percent, and anything above 255 means every time.
byField.percent_say_what: The chance, a real percentage, of saying "what?" during the listening window.
byField.persist_offscreen: Whether it survives the camera leaving; without it the object dies on any screen change and is rebuilt from its marker on return.
byField.persistant: Whether it is kept alive beyond the screen instead of being removed and respawned fresh on return: a Fleech keeps simulating, a Scrab freezes where it stands.
byField.possessed_max_whirl_attack_duration: The frame cap on a spin attack already underway; expiring cuts it straight into a run.
byField.pre_chase_delay: Frames of "freeze!" before the chase; zero skips the pause, and it shouts and chases at once.
byField.right_max_delay: The longest stand at the patrol's end while facing right.
byField.right_min_delay: The shortest stand at the patrol's end while facing right.
byField.roar_randomly: Whether it shrieks at random between actions; live in Oddysee, never read in Exoddus.
byField.scale: Which plane the object sits on: foreground, or the half-scale background.
byField.shoot_on_sight_delay: How long the Slig waits after spotting Abe before it shoots; 0 means it shoots on sight, with no "FREEZE!" warning.
byField.slig_bound_persist_id: The id tying a Slig to its bound posts and persist pins: the pen it patrols, and the spots that let it outlive the screen.
byField.slig_id: The pairing key of a Slig's pen: the slig whose bound id matches takes this post as an edge, or this pin as an off-screen foothold.
byField.slig_spawner_switch_id: The switch that fires a slig spawner; dead on a placed Slig or a pants locker, where only a spawner's copy is ever read.
byField.spawn_delay_state: Whether it starts moving immediately or waits out its spawn move delay first.
byField.spawn_move_delay: Frames held inactive before it starts patrolling.
byField.spawner_switch_id: The switch the spawner watches: it produces while this reads on.
byField.start_direction: Which way it faces or sets off when the level starts.
byField.stay_awake: For a sleeper: woken once, whether it comes back awake on your next visit instead of asleep again.
byField.stop_chase_delay: Frames before it gives up a chase.
byField.switch_id: The switch number this object is wired to. Every object sharing a number acts on the same switch.
byField.talk_to_abe: Read by nothing in either game.
byField.time_to_wait_before_chase: The delay before a chase-state slig starts hunting, in frames.
byField.trigger_switch_id: Written on touch: the stone sets this switch the moment Abe's palm lands.
byField.unlimited_spawns: Whether the spawner re-arms each time its slig dies; only a spawner reads it, and it writes the switch back off as it re-arms.
byField.x_velocity: The sideways toss the dropped bundle gets, in fixed-point hundredths or so of a unit per frame.
byField.y_velocity: The upward toss the dropped bundle gets: the stored value is negated so the bundle flies up.
byField.z_shoot_delay: Frames before it fires across the depth axis at a target on the other plane.
byField.zone_number: The checkpoint zone's number: crossing into a different zone is what makes the game re-save.

byGameType.BgAnimSounds: Whether the animation carries a looping sound; fire is the only sound implemented.
byGameType.CrawlingSligButtonSounds: The sound the button borrows for this press outcome: the game reuses effects from other machines here.
byGameType.DoorStates: In Exoddus, the state the door holds while its switch is off; the switch flips it. In Oddysee this picks the door's kind instead (the third value is the hub gate), and whether it starts closed is its own field.
byGameType.DoorTypes: What kind of door this is: a plain doorway, or a tasks gate that opens only when its hub switches are all on.
byGameType.DrillDirection: Which surface the drill punches from; its numbering is the drill's own, not the usual left and right.
byGameType.ElectricWallStartState: Whether the wall is electrified when the level starts.
byGameType.FootSwitchTriggerBy: Who can set this floor switch off.
byGameType.GasColour: The colour of the gas this emitter releases.
byGameType.GlukkonTypes: Whether this is a plain Glukkon or one of the named story characters.
byGameType.InvisibleSwitchScale: Which plane a character must be on to trip it: a filter on who can trigger, not a size.
byGameType.Layer: The drawing layer the animation renders on; only the first three values pick distinct layers, anything higher keeps the default.
byGameType.LevelIds: Which level the destination sits in, as the game's own level table numbers them.
byGameType.LeverSoundDirection: Which side the machinery sound plays from: stereo dressing pointing at the machine being operated.
byGameType.LeverSoundType: The machinery sound played on top of the lever's own clack, chosen by the state the switch ended up in; it only plays when the value actually changed.
byGameType.LiftPointStopType: Which stop on the lift's route this point marks.
byGameType.Mud_State: The work this Mudokon is busy with when Abe finds it, or the ring it gives instead.
byGameType.Mud_TLV_Emotion: The mood this Mudokon starts in.
byGameType.MusicTriggerMusicType: Which music slot the cue drives; the chase slots resolve per level, the rest are fixed pieces, and each slot carries its own built-in duration.
byGameType.Path_BeeSwarmHole::MovementType: What each new swarm does the moment the hole releases it.
byGameType.Path_BoomMachine::NozzleSide: Which side of the button the grenade nozzle hangs on.
byGameType.Path_ContinuePoint::Scale: A filter on which plane's Abe can trip this checkpoint, and it reads inverted: half fires for a full-scale Abe, full for a half-scale one.
byGameType.Path_ContinuePoint::spawnDirection: Which way Abe faces when he restarts here.
byGameType.Path_CrawlingSlig::CrawlDirection: Which way it sets off when panic starts; random is a single coin flip at spawn, not wandering.
byGameType.Path_CrawlingSlig::State: What the Crawling Slig is doing when the level starts.
byGameType.Path_DoorFlame::Colour: Nudges one channel of the flame's tint, a subtle push toward red, green or blue. Exoddus keeps the field but never reads it.
byGameType.Path_DoorFlame::Scale: Which plane the flame sits on; both half values behave identically.
byGameType.Path_Edge::GrabDirection: Which way Abe must be facing to catch the lip; the third value takes either.
byGameType.Path_EnemyStopper::StopDirection: The direction of travel it blocks, compared against the creature's motion, not against which side of the marker it stands on.
byGameType.Path_FlyingSlig_Data::SpawnDelayStates: Whether it starts moving immediately or waits out its spawn delay first, and nothing more.
byGameType.Path_Glukkon::Behavior: Whether he actually patrols, or stands where he is, turning and muttering.
byGameType.Path_Glukkon::SpawnType: How he makes his entrance when his spawn switch brings him in: plain, offset to a side, or the full teleport show.
byGameType.Path_Glukkon::StartDirection: Which way he faces at the start.
byGameType.Path_GlukkonSwitch::Scale: Which plane the intercom serves; the values read opposite to the usual scale fields.
byGameType.Path_Hoist::GrabDirection: Which way the grabber must be facing to take hold; the third value takes either.
byGameType.Path_Hoist::Type: Where this hoist carries Abe when he grabs it; the engine only singles out the off-screen kind, and the other two behave alike.
byGameType.Path_LiftMover::YDirection: Which way this mover drives its lift.
byGameType.Path_LiftMudokon::Direction: Which way he faces at the start.
byGameType.Path_LightEffect::Type: Which glow this is: it picks the behaviour as well as the art. The stars famously never render.
byGameType.Path_MeatSaw::StartState: Whether the saw is running when the level starts; the free-running kind ignores it and always runs.
byGameType.Path_MeatSaw::Type: Which of three machines this is: a free-running cycler, a switch-gated two-tempo saw (the plain automatic value), or one stroke per trigger.
byGameType.Path_MotionDetector::InitialMoveDirectio: Which way the beam sweeps first, and which end it starts from.
byGameType.Path_Mudokon::MudJobs: The work this Mudokon is busy with when Abe finds it.
byGameType.Path_Paramite::EntranceType: How the Paramite arrives when Abe reaches it.
byGameType.Path_RingMudokon::MustFaceMud: Whether Abe must be facing the Mudokon for the greeting to count.
byGameType.Path_Slig::ShootPossessedSligs: Whether it fires on a Slig Abe is possessing.
byGameType.Path_Slig::StartState: The Slig's initial AI behaviour before it notices Abe.
byGameType.Path_TrapDoor::StartState: The trap door's state when the level starts.
byGameType.Path_ZBall::Speed: Which of the three baked swing animations plays: the swing is animation, not physics.
byGameType.Path_ZBall::StartPos: Where in the arc the ball starts, staggering a row out of phase; it also decides which ball owns the swing sound.
byGameType.PortalSide: Which half of the screen the portal masks: the side Abe disappears behind, and on an exit the side he comes out facing.
byGameType.PortalType: Who this bird portal is for.
byGameType.PullRingSoundDirection: Which side the machinery sound plays from.
byGameType.PullRingSwitchSound: The machinery sound played for the pull's outcome; in Oddysee an original bug keeps these from ever playing.
byGameType.ScrabPatrolType: How the Scrab paces its territory before it spots Abe.
byGameType.ScrabSpawnDirection: Nudges the spawn point one grid cell to a side; it does not set the Scrab's facing.
byGameType.ScreenChangeEffects: The transition the crossing plays; the first value plays the movie named by the movie field instead of a wipe.
byGameType.ShadowZoneScale: Which plane's sprites the zone tints.
byGameType.StartDirection: Which way the spawned Slog sets off; the numbering is opposite the Slog's own direction field.
byGameType.SwitchOp: What triggering this does to the switch value it is wired to.
byGameType.TPageAbr: Which of the PlayStation's four blend modes the transparency uses.
byGameType.TriggeredBy: What sets the cue off. In Oddysee touching behaves as a plain delay: its triggers carry no position test.
byGameType.WheelSyncerOutputRequirement: The boolean rule the gate applies over its inputs to compute its output, every frame.
byGameType.XDirection_int: Which way the object faces or travels.
byGameType.XDirection_short: Which way the object faces or travels.

byType.AbeStart.scale: Never read, like the rest of the stored words.
byType.AbeStart.x_position: Never read; the position is the rectangle itself.
byType.AbeStart.y_position: Never read; the position is the rectangle itself.
byType.Alarm.duration: How long the klaxon rings, in frames.
byType.BackgroundAnimation.is_semi_trans: Whether the animation draws transparent; no shipped placement does.
byType.BackgroundAnimation.sound_effect: Whether the animation carries a looping sound; fire is the only sound implemented, and Exoddus never reads it.
byType.Bat.attack_duration: Frames it stays latched to a target before flying up to die.
byType.Bat.speed: The cruise speed it accelerates to along its line.
byType.Bat.ticks_before_moving: Frames from spawn before it wakes and starts flying. Staggered values launch a colony in waves.
byType.BeeSwarmHole.chase_time: Frames each swarm hunts before dispersing.
byType.BeeSwarmHole.fall_switch_id: Copied in and read by nothing.
byType.Bees.amount_of_bees: The size of the harmless ambient swarm drifting around the nest.
byType.Bees.chase_time: Frames the angry swarm hunts before it disperses.
byType.Bees.swarm_size: The size of the angry swarm the switch releases.
byType.BellHammer.action: Never read; the hammer always clears its switch back to zero after the swing.
byType.BellSongStone.type: Whether the digits play as whistles or as chimes: the same tune either way.
byType.BirdPortal.birdportalexit_camera: The travel ride's arrival camera; live only on a travel portal.
byType.BirdPortal.birdportalexit_path: The travel ride's arrival path; live only on a travel portal.
byType.BirdPortal.camera_destination: The travel ride's arrival camera; live only on a travel portal.
byType.BirdPortal.create_portal_switch_id: The portal is only built while this reads on; the always-on id 1 makes it unconditional.
byType.BirdPortal.delete_portal_switch_id: Checked as the portal dies: on means it never comes back.
byType.BirdPortal.movie_id: The film the level change plays; zero is an instant change, and a worker or Shrykull portal never travels at all.
byType.BirdPortal.mudokon_amount_for_shrykull: The Shrykull countdown: each rescue decrements it, and the doves only pour back into Abe once it reaches zero; live only on a shrykull portal.
byType.BirdPortal.path_destination: The travel ride's arrival path; live only on a travel portal.
byType.BoneBag.bone_amount: How many bones this bag holds.
byType.BoneBag.bone_fall_direction: Which way the bones fall out of the bag.
byType.BrewMachine.brew_count: Servings in the machine; the remaining count is written into the marker itself between visits.
byType.ChimeLock.password_switch_id: Read once, at spawn: the song stone's "Abe has heard this" flag; off, and the lock cannot be solved by hand at all.
byType.ChimeLock.solve_switch_id: Set on when the lock solves itself; read back at spawn so a solved lock returns inert.
byType.ColourfulMeter.mines_alarm_countdown: The seconds on the clock the full bar starts; a draining gauge never reads it.
byType.ColourfulMeter.number_of_meter_bars: How many contributing switches fill the shared bar; it also sets the segments each contribution paints.
byType.ColourfulMeter.start_filled: Picks the machine: a draining gauge, or the shared progress bar several meters show together.
byType.ContinuePoint.clear_from_id: Stored on Abe and round-tripped through the save, but never acted on.
byType.ContinuePoint.clear_to_id: Stored on Abe and round-tripped through the save, but never acted on.
byType.ContinuePoint.elum_restarts: Whether this checkpoint also moves Elum's respawn point forward.
byType.ContinuePoint.save_file_id: The number stamped on the quicksave this checkpoint writes: a per-area code, not a slot.
byType.ContinueZone.zone_number: Never read: the zones are the designers' own map of which checkpoint governs where.
byType.CrawlingSlig.panic_switch_id: Read only: while on, a sleeper wakes straight into the scramble for a locker, skipping idle entirely.
byType.CrawlingSlig.respawn_on_death: Whether the Crawling Slig comes back after it is killed.
byType.CrawlingSlig.start_direction: Never read; the crawl direction field is what sets its facing.
byType.CrawlingSligButton.sound_direction: Stored, then never used as a direction: it leaks into the sound's left and right volume as a broken pan, an original quirk.
byType.DeathClock.start_switch_id: The clock starts counting when this comes on; its stop switch is hardwired in the engine, not a field.
byType.DeathDrop.action: Dead data, zero in every placement.
byType.DeathDrop.animation: Dead data, zero in every placement.
byType.DeathDrop.id: Dead data, zero in every placement.
byType.DeathDrop.set_value: Dead data, zero in every placement.
byType.DeathDrop.sound: Dead data, zero in every placement.
byType.Door.abe_direction_on_exit: Which way Abe faces when he comes out of this door, wired backwards in both games: a door authored right faces him left.
byType.Door.clear_throwables: Entering deletes everything Abe is carrying.
byType.Door.close_on_exit: After Abe steps out, the door shuts behind him and starts closed from then on.
byType.Door.door_closed: Whether the Oddysee door starts closed: the real state flag, since Oddysee's start_state picks the door's kind instead.
byType.Door.door_number: This door's own number, unique only within its camera, which is why numbers repeat freely across a level.
byType.Door.hub_1_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.hub_2_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.hub_3_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.hub_4_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.hub_5_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.hub_6_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.hub_7_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.hub_8_id: One of a gate door's eight watched inputs; unused slots are wired to the always-on id 1 so the AND can pass.
byType.Door.target_door_id: The partner's door number, looked up inside the destination camera only.
byType.Door.target_door_number: The partner's door number, looked up inside the destination camera only.
byType.Door.wipe_effect: The transition the crossing plays; the first value plays the door's movie instead of a wipe.
byType.Door.wipe_x_org: Declared and read by nothing in either game.
byType.Door.wipe_y_org: Declared and read by nothing in either game.
byType.Door.x_offset: Nudges the door art sideways from its snapped spot.
byType.Door.y_offset: Nudges the door art vertically from its snapped spot.
byType.DoorFlame.colour: Nudges one channel of the flame's tint; Exoddus keeps the field but never reads it.
byType.Dove.dove_count: How many birds this one marker scatters.
byType.Dove.pixel_perfect: Pins every bird to the marker's exact corner instead of scattering them across its box.
byType.Drill.behavior: Which machine this is: a free-running cycler, a switch-gated drill, or a one-stroke-per-use drill that resets its own switch.
byType.Drill.max_off_time: The longest idle between full-speed strokes, in frames.
byType.Drill.max_off_time_speed_change: The longest idle between off-speed strokes, in frames.
byType.Drill.min_off_time: The shortest idle between full-speed strokes, in frames; nearly every drill ships zero and never pauses.
byType.Drill.min_off_time_speed_change: The shortest idle between off-speed strokes, in frames.
byType.Drill.off_speed: The cycle speed while the switch disagrees; zero stops the drill dead instead.
byType.Drill.speed: The stroke speed in units per frame, except exactly 250, which the engine special-cases to the slowest crawl in the game.
byType.Drill.start_position_bottom: Starts the drill fully extended rather than retracted.
byType.Drill.start_state_on: Inverts the switch sense: with it set, the drill runs while the switch is off.
byType.Edge.can_grab: Whether the lip can be caught at all; in both games a no-grab edge parked on a hoist blocks the falling catch, though a run-jump still takes the hoist.
byType.ElumPathTrans.camera: Never read; only level and path are matched.
byType.ExplosionSet.grid_spacing: Where the march starts, in grid squares from the rect's near edge.
byType.ExplosionSet.increasing_grid_spacing: How far each rock lands beyond the last, in grid squares; the march wraps at the far edge.
byType.ExplosionSet.spawn_assets: Whether the bombardment drops debris at all, or only shakes the screen.
byType.ExplosionSet.start_delay: Frames before the first rock, once enabled.
byType.ExplosionSet.start_direction: Which end of the rect the march sets off from.
byType.ExplosionSet.start_enabled: Whether it runs from the start; every shipped one waits for the mines alarm instead.
byType.FallingItem.fall_interval: Frames between arming and the drop.
byType.FallingItem.max_falling_items: How many drops it has; zero means unlimited.
byType.FallingItem.reset_switch_id_after_use: Sets the switch back off on impact, so a one-shot trigger re-arms itself.
byType.Fleech.attack_anger_increaser: Double duty: the anger each speech, alarm or loud noise adds, and the threshold at which it commits to the chase.
byType.Fleech.can_wake_up_switch_id: A hard gate: while this reads off, the whole wake check is skipped and it sleeps through anything.
byType.Fleech.goes_to_sleep: Whether it settles back down once its anger decays: always onto the floor, never back to a hanging sleep.
byType.Fleech.hanging: Whether the Fleech starts hanging from the ceiling.
byType.Fleech.lost_target_timeout: How long it keeps re-approaching a target it has lost before giving up and cooling off.
byType.Fleech.patrol_range: A leash around wherever it first woke, in grid squares; it stops at the edge rather than turning.
byType.Fleech.wake_up_switch_anger_value: The anger added when its wake switch flips while it is already roaming.
byType.Fleech.wake_up_switch_id: Read only: this switch changing value feeds the anger meter; it is a prod, not a command.
byType.FlyingSlig.persistant: Backwards from its name: its one effect is that a possessed flying slig dies on a path change rather than following Abe across.
byType.FlyingSlig.slig_bound_persist_id: Never read: a flying slig ignores bound ids and leashes to whatever posts sit near its rail's ends.
byType.FlyingSlig.spawner_switch_id: Dead on a placed flying slig; only the spawner reads its own copy.
byType.FlyingSligSpawner.listen_time: How long the spawned slig stands listening after a noise, in frames, before going back to its business.
byType.FlyingSligSpawner.persistant: Handed to the spawned slig, where it reads backwards: possessed, the slig dies on a path change rather than following Abe across.
byType.FlyingSligSpawner.slig_bound_persist_id: Never read: a flying slig ignores bound ids and leashes to whatever posts sit near its rail's ends.
byType.GasCountdown.gas_countdown_time: The countdown's length in frames; the display divides by thirty.
byType.GasCountdown.stop_timer_switch_id: Would cancel the countdown; every shipped placement wires it to the never-on id 0.
byType.Glukkon.death_switch_id: Written when a story executive is killed the wrong way, outside his intended movie exit.
byType.Glukkon.help_switch_id: Written, not read: the instant his "help!" fires, this switch goes on, and it clears again when he calms, is slapped, is possessed or dies.
byType.Glukkon.movie_to_play: The film his intended exit plays, read once when the movie starts.
byType.Glukkon.pal_id: Which palette recolours the Board Room executive.
byType.Glukkon.play_movie_switch_id: Polled while he is player-controlled: on, it routes him into his movie exit.
byType.Glukkon.scale_percent: The sprite's size as a percentage.
byType.Glukkon.scream_help_delay: The pause between his first "hey" and the actual "help!", in frames; chanting nearby shortens it.
byType.Glukkon.spawn_delay: The countdown between his spawn switch firing and the entrance, in frames.
byType.Glukkon.spawn_switch_id: Read while he waits hidden: he materialises when it comes on.
byType.Glukkon.target_id: Copied in and read by nothing.
byType.Glukkon.to_calm_delay: Frames of nothing alarming before he calms down and clears his help switch; the same delay paces recovery from a slap.
byType.Glukkon.voice_adjust: Copied in and read by nothing: the jeering pitch is rolled at random.
byType.GlukkonSwitch.fail_switch_id: Set on when the wrong voice answers; every shipped intercom leaves it at zero, so being caught costs nothing.
byType.GlukkonSwitch.ok_switch_id: Toggled on a correct Glukkon answer; answer twice and it flips back.
byType.GlukkonSwitch.x_position: Where the intercom's voice draws, offset from the path's Abe-start origin; zero centres it in the box.
byType.GlukkonSwitch.y_position: Where the intercom's voice draws, offset from the path's Abe-start origin; zero centres it in the box.
byType.Greeter.motion_detector_speed: Stored and never read: the beam's sweep is hardcoded.
byType.Greeter.start_direction: Wired backwards on the greeter: left starts it rolling right.
byType.HandStone.camera_1_level: The first view's level. An Oddysee stone names a full screen anywhere in the game.
byType.HandStone.camera_2_level: The second view's level; the chain ends on a sentinel level id.
byType.HandStone.camera_3_level: The third view's level; the chain ends on a sentinel level id.
byType.HandStone.camera_id_1: The first view: a camera within your own path.
byType.HandStone.camera_id_2: The second view: a camera within your own path; zero ends the chain.
byType.HandStone.camera_id_3: The third view: a camera within your own path; zero ends the chain.
byType.HintFly.message_id: Which line of the game's own hint table the flies spell out.
byType.Hoist.switch_id: Declared with the decomp's own note: never used.
byType.Honey.scale: Never read; the puddle's presence is its whole content.
byType.Honey.state: Never read; the puddle's presence is its whole content.
byType.Honey.switch_id: Never read; the puddle's presence is its whole content.
byType.HoneySack.chase_time: Frames the released swarm hunts you after the sack smashes.
byType.IdSplitter.id_1: One of the four outputs the splitter toggles; unused slots stay zero.
byType.IdSplitter.id_2: One of the four outputs the splitter toggles; unused slots stay zero.
byType.IdSplitter.id_3: One of the four outputs the splitter toggles; unused slots stay zero.
byType.IdSplitter.id_4: One of the four outputs the splitter toggles; unused slots stay zero.
byType.IdSplitter.source_switch_id: The one input: its change is what fans out.
byType.IdSplitter.trigger_interval: The delay between the input changing and the outputs toggling, in frames.

byType.InvisibleSwitch.set_off_alarm: Whether tripping this switch raises the alarm.
byType.LCD.message_1_id: The fixed message shown while the toggle switch is off, alternating with a random one from the range.
byType.LCD.message_2_id: The fixed message shown while the toggle switch is on.
byType.LCD.random_message_max_id: The top of the random-message range.
byType.LCD.random_message_min_id: The bottom of the random-message range the board alternates through.
byType.LCD.toggle_message_switch_id: Picks between the two fixed messages, turning a whole bank of boards over on one switch; one Mines board retires its wheel hint into a Slig vacation ad this way.
byType.LCDScreen.message_1_id: The fixed message, alternating with a random one from the range.
byType.LCDScreen.random_message_max_id: The top of the random-message range.
byType.LCDScreen.random_message_min_id: The bottom of the random-message range the board alternates through.
byType.LCDStatusBoard.hide_board: Suppresses the display only: the board still stamps the zulag number and headcount as the screen loads.
byType.LCDStatusBoard.number_of_mudokons: The area's Mudokon headcount, which the board's second row counts down from as workers are rescued or killed.
byType.LCDStatusBoard.zulag_number: Which Zulag this board reports on.
byType.LaughingGas.blue: Dead: the render hardcodes its colour; the constructor even copies blue into the green slot, invisibly.
byType.LaughingGas.green: Dead: the render hardcodes its colour; the constructor even copies blue into the green slot, invisibly.
byType.LaughingGas.is_laughing_gas: Off would make a harmless white mist that sets no flag; every shipped placement is the yellow kind.
byType.LaughingGas.laughing_gas_switch_id: The haze ramps up while this is on and fades when it goes off.
byType.LaughingGas.red: Dead: the render hardcodes its colour; the constructor even copies blue into the green slot, invisibly.
byType.LevelLoader.destination_level: Which level this loader sends Abe to.
byType.LiftMover.lift_mover_switch_id: The switch that calls the lift: on sends it the mover's way, off brings it back.
byType.LiftMover.target_lift_point_id: The lift point id of the platform it drives.
byType.LiftMudokon.how_far_to_walk: The walk-in and walk-out distance of the one-shot helper.
byType.LiftMudokon.lift_switch_id: A pairing number matching a LiftPoint's own id, not a switch, despite the name.
byType.LiftPoint.ignore_lift_mover: A middle floor a mover sails past; a rider can still stop there.
byType.LiftPoint.lift_point_id: The platform's id: what a lift mover targets, and, in Oddysee, what a lift Mudokon is paired to.
byType.LiftPoint.lift_type: Read by nothing; Exoddus ships junk values in it.
byType.LiftPoint.start_point: Marks the one marker in the shaft that becomes the platform; the rest are its stops.
byType.LightEffect.size: The glow is stretched to this square size; the switchable lights force it to native size instead, and the stars never read it.
byType.LocalWell.disabled_xpos: The landing spot while the switch is off; Exoddus computes a ballistic arc to it.
byType.LocalWell.disabled_ypos: The landing spot while the switch is off; Exoddus computes a ballistic arc to it.
byType.LocalWell.enabled_xpos: The landing spot while the switch is on; Exoddus computes a ballistic arc to it.
byType.LocalWell.enabled_ypos: The landing spot while the switch is on; Exoddus computes a ballistic arc to it.
byType.LocalWell.leaf_xpos: Where the drifting leaves start; zero falls back to the well's own spot.
byType.LocalWell.leaf_ypos: Where the drifting leaves start; zero falls back to the well's own spot.
byType.MeatSack.amount_of_meat: How much meat this sack holds.
byType.MeatSack.meat_fall_direction: Which way the meat falls out of the sack.
byType.MeatSaw.automatic_max_time_off: The longest idle between off-speed strokes, in frames; only a two-tempo saw ever reads it.
byType.MeatSaw.automatic_min_time_off: The shortest idle between off-speed strokes, in frames; only a two-tempo saw ever reads it.
byType.MeatSaw.initial_position: Starts the saw at the bottom of its stroke, already rising.
byType.MeatSaw.max_rise_time: The stroke length in world units, despite the name.
byType.MeatSaw.off_speed: The stroke speed while the switch disagrees with the saw's running sense; zero stops a type-1 saw dead instead.
byType.MeatSaw.speed: How far the saw travels per frame, in world units.
byType.MeatSaw.switch_max_time_off: The longest idle between strokes while running normally, in frames.
byType.MeatSaw.switch_min_time_off: The shortest idle between strokes while running normally, in frames.
byType.Mine.num_patterns: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.Mine.pattern: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.MineCar.max_damage: Copied in and read by nothing.
byType.MotionDetector.alarm_duration: How long the tripped alarm holds its switch on, in frames.
byType.MotionDetector.alarm_switch_id: Set on for the alarm's duration when something moves through the beam.
byType.MotionDetector.device_x: Where the emitter sits: Exoddus offsets it from the path's Abe-start origin, zero falling back to the marker's corner; Oddysee stores the plain world position.
byType.MotionDetector.device_y: Where the emitter sits: Exoddus offsets it from the path's Abe-start origin, zero falling back to the marker's corner; Oddysee stores the plain world position.
byType.MotionDetector.disable_switch_id: While on, the beam hides and the whole detector sleeps.
byType.MotionDetector.draw_flare: Whether the emitter's flare renders; in Exoddus a hidden flare also makes the beam untrippable, in Oddysee it stays live and invisible.
byType.MotionDetector.speed: The beam's sweep speed, stored in 256ths of a unit per frame.
byType.MovieStone.fmv_id: Which film of the current level's movie table plays.
byType.MovieStone.scale: Never read; only the film number is.
byType.MovingBomb.max_rise: Dead data in both games, plausible-looking values and all.
byType.MovingBomb.speed: The cruising speed, stored in 256ths of a unit per frame.
byType.MovingBomb.start_moving_switch_id: The bomb rolls while this reads on; most are wired to the always-on id 1.
byType.MovingBomb.start_speed: The speed it sets off at before accelerating to cruise, in 256ths of a unit per frame.
byType.MovingBomb.triggered_by_alarm: Spawns the bomb invisible until the level alarm sounds: a switch never enters into it.
byType.MovingBombStopper.max_delay: The longest pause a bomb takes inside the stopper, in frames.
byType.MovingBombStopper.min_delay: The shortest pause a bomb takes inside the stopper, in frames.
byType.Mudokon.angry_switch_id: While on, a short fuse ends with the worker standing up angry.
byType.Mudokon.blind: Whether this Mudokon can't see Abe, so it won't stop as he passes.
byType.Mudokon.deaf: Whether this Mudokon ignores Abe's speech, so gamespeak won't reach it; live in Oddysee, never read in Exoddus.
byType.Mudokon.gets_depressed: Gates the sad mood entirely: without it, a response that would sadden the worker is discarded.
byType.Mudokon.persist_reset_offscreen: Whether it survives a screen change; a ring giver always dies on one regardless.
byType.Mudokon.rescue_switch_id: The switch number set when this Mudokon is rescued.
byType.Mudokon.ring_pulse_interval: How long the gifted ring lasts, in frames; zero means effectively forever.
byType.Mudokon.state: What this Mudokon is doing when the level starts.
byType.Mudokon.voice_pitch: Each placed worker's own voice, fed straight to its speech effects.
byType.Mudokon.work_after_turning_wheel: Required for a wheel-turning worker to answer a greeting at all; it stops turning when its wheel's switch comes on.
byType.MudokonPathTrans.camera: Never read: the marker's presence is the whole signal.
byType.MudokonPathTrans.level: Never read: the marker's presence is the whole signal.
byType.MudokonPathTrans.path: Never read: the marker's presence is the whole signal.
byType.MultiSwitchController.on_off_delay: The window, in frames, within which all six inputs must land; missing it wipes every input to zero.
byType.MusicTrigger.music_delay: The chime type's duration in frames; in Oddysee also the play length a switch-driven trigger uses in place of its slot's own, and the delay a touching-type trigger really is.
byType.Null.padding1: A retired object's leftover word: most likely Oddysee's Preloader flag carried forward.
byType.Paramite.alone_chase_delay: The windup after the warning hiss before a lone Paramite charges; only applies when it hisses first.
byType.Paramite.attack_fleeches: Whether the idle swing at a facing Fleech actually connects; the animation plays regardless.
byType.Paramite.delete_when_far_away: Beyond about a screen and a half it is destroyed; set to no, it freezes in place instead and resumes when you return.
byType.Paramite.delete_when_out_of_sight: Removal beyond about two screens: inert for the common entrance types, which never set the flag it tests.
byType.Paramite.enter_from_web: Spawns it dropping in on a silk thread it makes for itself, instead of standing on patrol.
byType.Paramite.group_chase_delay: The commitment timer once a chase starts: it won't bail back to patrol while this is unexpired.
byType.Paramite.meat_eating_time: Frames spent eating thrown meat; the meal only ever tempts an idle Paramite, never one already chasing.
byType.Paramite.surprise_web_delay: The pause between the drop's trigger and the drop, in frames.
byType.Paramite.surprise_web_switch_id: The web drop's switch. In Oddysee an override, checked when the natural trigger (Abe crossing to its far side) hasn't fired; in Exoddus the only trigger, and zero never drops.
byType.PathTransition.movie: The film for a movie transition.
byType.PathTransition.next_path_scale: The traveller's scale on the far side; in Oddysee anything that walks across is rescaled, not just Abe.
byType.PathTransition.scale: The scale Abe takes on the far side of the crossing; the marker itself spawns nothing and sits on no plane.
byType.PathTransition.wipe: The transition the crossing plays; the first value plays its movie instead of a wipe.
byType.Preloader.unload_cams_asap: Never read; whatever it once meant, the designers were still setting it.
byType.PullRingRope.rope_length: How far below the anchor the ring hangs, in world units.
byType.Pulley.scale: Never read; only the pulley's spot is.
byType.ResetPath.clear_ids: Whether the switch wipe happens at all.
byType.ResetPath.clear_objects: Whether every object in the named path is reset to never-yet-spawned.
byType.ResetPath.exclude: The one id spared inside the range; no shipped placement spares any.
byType.ResetPath.from: The first switch id of the wiped range.
byType.ResetPath.path: Which path gets the reset, never the one the marker sits in.
byType.ResetPath.to: The last switch id of the wiped range, inclusive.
byType.ResetSwitchRange.enabled: Misleadingly named: it means repeatable; off, the line fires once and latches.
byType.ResetSwitchRange.end_switch_id: The last switch id of the wiped range, inclusive; live only where the sweep is switched on.
byType.ResetSwitchRange.free_path_resources: Would free another path's object resources; no shipped placement uses it.
byType.ResetSwitchRange.path_id_to_free_resourc: The path whose resources the unused free option would release.
byType.ResetSwitchRange.reset_switches: Whether the id sweep happens at all.
byType.ResetSwitchRange.skip_switch_id: The one id spared inside the range; live only where the sweep is switched on.
byType.ResetSwitchRange.start_switch_id: The first switch id of the wiped range; live only where the sweep is switched on.
byType.RingMudokon.action: Read as a job rather than a switch operation: the first value has him pull a lever for Abe; any other, chant a ring.
byType.RingMudokon.ring_and_angry_mudokon_timeo: The gifted ring's lifetime in frames; zero means effectively forever.
byType.RockSack.rock_amount: How many rocks this sack holds.
byType.RockSack.rock_fall_direction: Which way the rocks fall out of the sack.
byType.RollingBall.acceleration: How fast it gathers speed, in the same 256ths.
byType.RollingBall.release_switch_id: The boulder rolls when this comes on; the stopper wedge writes it as it falls away.
byType.RollingBall.speed: The top rolling speed, stored in 256ths of a unit per frame.
byType.RollingBallStopper.ball_switch_id: Written by the falling wedge: the ball's release switch.
byType.RollingBallStopper.stopper_switch_id: The wedge tumbles away when this comes on.
byType.Scrab.attack_delay: The reaction hesitation: frames it idles on first spotting prey it can't yet reach; Exoddus arms it once per chase, Oddysee re-arms it whenever the Scrab falls back to idle.
byType.Scrab.spotting_abe_delay: Armed once on entering the chase; losing sight can only end the chase after it expires.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_attack_delay: The spawned Scrab's reaction hesitation, in frames.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_disabled_resources: Read by nothing, as on the Scrab itself.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_kill_enemy: Unreachable dead code, as on the Scrab itself.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_left_max_delay: The spawned Scrab's longest stand while facing left.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_left_min_delay: The spawned Scrab's shortest stand while facing left.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_patrol_type_run_or_wa: How often the spawned Scrab runs a patrol leg rather than walks it; higher means more running.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_pause_after_chase_del: The spawned Scrab's hunt-from-memory grace, in frames.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_persistant: Whether the spawned Scrab is kept beyond the screen, frozen where it stands, instead of being removed.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_right_max_delay: The spawned Scrab's longest stand while facing right.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_right_min_delay: The spawned Scrab's shortest stand while facing right.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_roar_randamly: Never read in Exoddus, the only game with the spawner.
byType.ScrabSpawner.scrab_whirl_attack_duration: The frame cap on the spawned Scrab's spin attack.
byType.SecurityClaw.alarm_duration: How long the raised alarm holds its switch on, in frames.
byType.SecurityClaw.alarm_switch_id: Set on for the alarm's duration when gunfire or a blast sounds in its screen.
byType.SecurityClaw.unknown: A word belonging to Exoddus's armed chant suppressor, which the decompilation leaves unimplemented.
byType.SecurityDoor.x_position: Where the panel draws: Exoddus offsets it from the path's Abe-start origin, zero centring it in the box; Oddysee stores the plain world position.
byType.SecurityDoor.y_position: Where the panel draws: Exoddus offsets it from the path's Abe-start origin, zero centring it in the box; Oddysee stores the plain world position.
byType.ShadowZone.centre_h: Authored feather sizes the engine throws away: the falloff is hardcoded.
byType.ShadowZone.centre_w: Authored feather sizes the engine throws away: the falloff is hardcoded.
byType.SlamDoor.delete: Once the door finishes opening it removes itself for good: a one-shot door.
byType.SlamDoor.flip_on_y_axis: Mirrors the slab vertically, so it hangs and slams from above.
byType.SlamDoor.start_shut: The state at switch-off; the switch inverts it.
byType.SlapLock.give_invisibility_power_up: Whether breaking it hands Abe invisibility, and a broken one respawns as a permanent dispenser of it.
byType.SlapLock.has_ghost: Whether the lock holds a spirit at all.
byType.SlapLock.invisibility_duration: How long the granted invisibility lasts, in frames.
byType.SlapLock.target_tomb_id_1: A door number, not a switch: which tomb door the freed spirit flies into; no such door on the path, and the spirit dies at birth.
byType.SlapLock.target_tomb_id_2: A switch, set on when the spirit arrives; read back at spawn as "already delivered".
byType.SlapLock.toggle_switch_id: Toggled by the slap that breaks the lock.
byType.Slig.code_1: Read by nothing in either game: a fossil of a chant-code idea.
byType.Slig.code_2: Read by nothing in either game: a fossil of a chant-code idea.
byType.Slig.unknown: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.Slig.unknown1: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.SligGetPants.code_1: Read by nothing in either game: a fossil of a chant-code idea.
byType.SligGetPants.code_2: Read by nothing in either game: a fossil of a chant-code idea.
byType.SligGetPants.unknown1: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.SligGetWings.persistant: Handed to the flying slig a crawler becomes here; it reads backwards, killing a possessed one on a path change.
byType.SligGetWings.slig_bound_persist_id: Never read: a flying slig ignores bound ids and leashes to whatever posts sit near its rail's ends.
byType.SligGetWings.spawner_switch_id: Dead on the locker; only the spawner reads its own copy.
byType.SligSpawner.code_1: Read by nothing in either game: a fossil of a chant-code idea.
byType.SligSpawner.code_2: Read by nothing in either game: a fossil of a chant-code idea.
byType.SligSpawner.id: The switch that fires this spawner; Exoddus names the spawner's own trigger this way.
byType.SligSpawner.unknown: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.SlingMudokon.dont_whistle_password: Starts him asking for the password instead of teaching it: a variant no shipped placement uses.
byType.Slog.anger_switch_id: Read only, never written: while on, it goes straight to the charge, skipping even the wake-up animation.
byType.Slog.bark_anger: The increment above the wake threshold at which it barks; the numbers stack, they are not levels.
byType.Slog.bone_eating_time: Frames spent head-down on a thrown bone before the bone vanishes and the chase resumes.
byType.Slog.chase_anger: The increment above the bark point at which it charges. A thrown-object hit adds the whole charge threshold in one blow: all three anger numbers summed.
byType.Slog.chase_delay: Frames it idles before charging; Exoddus waits before every charge, Oddysee only after climbing to your level.
byType.Slog.wake_up_anger: The anger at which it wakes: an absolute threshold, and the floor below which it lies back down.
byType.SlogSpawner.chase_delay: Handed to the spawned Slog as its pause before charging.
byType.SlogSpawner.listen_to_sligs: Whether the spawned Slog obeys a possessed Slig's calls mid-chase; while idle it comes to heel regardless.
byType.SlogSpawner.max_slogs: The spawner's lifetime total, remembered across screen changes; at the quota it retires for good.
byType.SlogSpawner.max_slogs_at_a_time: A cap on every live Slog at once, not just this spawner's: neighbouring spawners share one ceiling, and a placed Slog counts against it.
byType.SlogSpawner.slog_spawn_interval: Frames between releases, plus a little jitter; the first Slog appears the moment the switch is on.
byType.Slurg.time_until_turning_around: Frames of inching before it stops for the turn animation; the direction only actually flips at a wall, a line's end or a Scrab bound.
byType.SlurgSpawner.max_slurgs: The lifetime quota, remembered across screen changes; a spawner that has met it stays spent.
byType.SlurgSpawner.time_until_turning_around: Handed to each spawned Slurg as its pause-and-turn timer.
byType.StatusLight.id_1: One of up to five switches the lamp watches: one still pending holds the green light steady, and one already on blinks the lamp red while the lamp's own switch stays off.
byType.StatusLight.id_2: One of up to five switches the lamp watches: one still pending holds the green light steady, and one already on blinks the lamp red while the lamp's own switch stays off.
byType.StatusLight.id_3: One of up to five switches the lamp watches: one still pending holds the green light steady, and one already on blinks the lamp red while the lamp's own switch stays off.
byType.StatusLight.id_4: One of up to five switches the lamp watches: one still pending holds the green light steady, and one already on blinks the lamp red while the lamp's own switch stays off.
byType.StatusLight.id_5: One of up to five switches the lamp watches: one still pending holds the green light steady, and one already on blinks the lamp red while the lamp's own switch stays off.
byType.StatusLight.ignore_grid_snapping: Skips the snap-and-drop to the floor, leaving the lamp exactly where the box puts it.
byType.Teleporter.camera_swap_effect: The transition the zap plays; the first value plays its movie instead of a wipe.
byType.Teleporter.electric_x: Where the ring sparks draw: the ring's position with the path's Abe-start origin added in; nothing special-cases zero, so an unset pair puts the sparks off the ring.
byType.Teleporter.electric_y: Where the ring sparks draw: the ring's position with the path's Abe-start origin added in; nothing special-cases zero, so an unset pair puts the sparks off the ring.
byType.Teleporter.other_teleporter_switch_id: The partner ring's pair number, matched inside the destination camera.
byType.Teleporter.teleporter_switch_id: This ring's own pair number, not a switch, despite the name.
byType.TimedMine.state: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.TimedMine.switch_id: Read by nothing in either game.
byType.TimedMine.ticks_before_explosion: The fuse in frames, started by the slap; the tick accelerates as it runs down.
byType.TimerTrigger.input_switch_id: The one input: leaving its starting value toggles the outputs, returning toggles them back.
byType.TimerTrigger.trigger_interval: The delay before the outputs toggle, in frames; a countdown in flight survives the screen changing.
byType.TorturedMudokon.kill_switch_id: Read as a state: on kills him mid-torture; whichever of the two switches fires first wins.
byType.TorturedMudokon.release_switch_id: Read as a state: on frees him for good, written back into the marker itself.
byType.TrapDoor.dest_level: Dead data in both games: every Exoddus door says Necrum Mines and not one means it.
byType.TrapDoor.self_closing: Whether the trap door falls shut again by itself.
byType.TrapDoor.stay_open_time: How long a self-closing door stays open, in frames; Oddysee hardcodes twenty instead.
byType.TrapDoor.x_offset: Render-only: the art shifts, the collision does not.
byType.UXB.pattern: The blink sequence as decimal digits: each digit is how many red blinks come before the next green.
byType.UXB.pattern_length: How many trailing digits of the pattern are read before it wraps; a length outside one to four collapses the pattern to its last digit.
byType.Water.max_drops: The particle pool's size, silently capped at 128.
byType.Water.splash_time: How long a drop's splash bounce lasts, in frames.
byType.Water.splash_x_velocity: The sideways kick given to drops and their splashes.
byType.Water.water_duration: A self-stop in frames; zero flows for as long as the switch is on.
byType.WellExpress.disabled_well_camera: The ride while the switch is off: its arrival camera.
byType.WellExpress.disabled_well_id: The ride while the switch is off: the arrival well's own number, scanned for inside the destination camera.
byType.WellExpress.disabled_well_path: The ride while the switch is off: its arrival path.
byType.WellExpress.enabled_well_camera: The ride while the switch is on: its arrival camera.
byType.WellExpress.enabled_well_id: The ride while the switch is on: the arrival well's own number, scanned for inside the destination camera.
byType.WellExpress.enabled_well_path: The ride while the switch is on: its arrival path.
byType.WellExpress.leaf_x: Where the drifting leaves start; zero falls back to the well's own spot.
byType.WellExpress.leaf_y: Where the drifting leaves start; zero falls back to the well's own spot.
byType.WellExpress.off_camera: The ride while the switch is off: its arrival camera.
byType.WellExpress.off_level: The ride while the switch is off: its arrival level.
byType.WellExpress.off_other_well_id: The ride while the switch is off: the arrival well's own number, scanned for inside the destination camera.
byType.WellExpress.off_path: The ride while the switch is off: its arrival path.
byType.WellExpress.on_camera: The ride while the switch is on: its arrival camera.
byType.WellExpress.on_other_well_id: The ride while the switch is on: the arrival well's own number, scanned for inside the destination camera.
byType.WellExpress.on_path: The ride while the switch is on: its arrival path.
byType.WellLocal.disabled_xpos: The shot while the switch is off; Oddysee reads it as a velocity in hundredths of a unit.
byType.WellLocal.disabled_ypos: The shot while the switch is off; Oddysee reads it as a velocity in hundredths of a unit.
byType.WellLocal.enabled_xpos: The shot while the switch is on; Oddysee reads it as a velocity in hundredths of a unit.
byType.WellLocal.enabled_ypos: The shot while the switch is on; Oddysee reads it as a velocity in hundredths of a unit.
byType.WellLocal.leaf_x: Where the drifting leaves start; zero falls back to the well's own spot.
byType.WellLocal.leaf_y: Where the drifting leaves start; zero falls back to the well's own spot.
byType.WorkWheel.activation_time: Frames of cranking before the switch comes on.
byType.WorkWheel.off_time: Keep cranking past this and the switch goes back off; zero means it can't be overturned.
byType.WorkWheel.turn_off_when_stopped: Whether letting go drops the switch again; most wheels latch instead.
